summary: Single-subject CLI status and owned-set member reads avoid building the full canonical claim ID vector

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/status accepts optional omit_claims=true. Its default remains unchanged. CLI show/inspect and other single-subject status consumers omit claim provenance (empty claims and default claims_summary); no claim counts or boundary queries run. Desired, actual, harness, conflicts and pending actions are unchanged. Owned-set response shapes are unchanged. Older daemons ignore the query and return the full vector.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes; reverting restores full claim ID enumeration.
